name: gemini-depth-perception
author: dorarobotics
description: Robot-agnostic Orbbec Gemini 335 RGB-D object perception with color filtering, depth distance, real-size estimation, and camera-frame 3D location.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Detect colored objects from Gemini 335 RGB-D data and filter by category, color, and actual metric size range. Does not move any robot.

category.description: Object category. Current color detector treats cube as the primary category.

size_range_m.description: Actual object size range in meters.

tools.name: locate_object_camera
tools.description: Return the best matching object's distance, estimated actual size, and 3D point in the Gemini 335 camera frame.

tools.name: get_object_distance
tools.description: Return only the best matching object's distance and estimated real size from Gemini 335 depth.
